title: Session-synchronized active-active failover with streaming continuity
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Design and implement an active-active failover mechanism for the hosted API edge/gateway that preserves streaming session continuity and meets SLO targets during cross-region shifts. This work covers traffic shifting logic, per-connection session reconciliation, coordinated draining, circuit breaker policies tuned for streaming, and adaptive load-shedding to protect tail latency and error budget. Deliverables include a failover protocol, control-plane APIs for orchestrating shifts, server/runtime changes for KV cache reconciliation and stream handoff, and tests/chaos experiments to validate SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Traffic can be shifted from region A to B without violating 99th-percentile end-to-end latency SLO for <key streaming paths> more than twice in a 30-day window
Active streaming sessions are either preserved or cleanly resumed (application-level tokens and KV cache continuity) in >= 95% of synthetic handoff trials
Circuit breakers open and recover according to documented thresholds; when open, graceful fallback to lower-cost model variants occurs without stream corruption
Control-plane API allows safe canary shifts with atomic per-session transfer, with metrics surfaced in the Console rollout dashboard
Automated chaos tests demonstrating graceful degradation and measurable error-budget consumption are in the E2E pipeline

comments: 2026-02-25 Priya Nambiar: Kickoff - initial spec stub added; motivation: customer incidents during region failovers where long-poll/stream sessions dropped and required re-auth. Need to preserve per-connection continuity and token/kv consistency.

2026-02-28 Ethan Cole: PoC notes - implemented a lightweight session token fanout that annotates stream frames with handoff markers. Observed ~12% additional latency on p95 during naive handoff. Planning to move reconciliation to background async KV pre-warm to reduce tail.
2026-03-03 Marta Ruiz: Design review - agreed on three-phase handoff: pre-warm, pointer-swap, drain-complete. UX for Console: allow operator to choose fast vs safe handoff modes.

2026-03-06 Alex Kim: SLO proposal - treat handoff as an SLO-impacting event; allocate 10% of monthly error budget for planned migrations; unplanned failovers counted against standard error budget. Need legal/PM buy-in.

2026-03-09 Sofia Alvarez: Circuit-breaker prototype - introduced streaming-aware CB that considers in-flight request window and uses a sliding-window error rate normalized by open-stream count. Early tests show fewer false positives during bursty traffic.

2026-03-11 QA Team: Test plan - preparing synthetic runner that creates long-lived streams with intermittent small payloads and verifies application-layer continuations after handoff. Will run in staging across three regions.

2026-03-13 Security: audit - requirement: every cross-region session transfer must create an append-only audit record with session-id, source-region, dest-region, initiator, and KMS-wrapped transfer token.
